title: Pinpointing the emotions
author: Ketaki Datta
text:
The fall of the leaves in autumn
has a song of its own,
The pain in the heart
has a strange tune unknown.
Could you tell me where
anguish stays ensconced exactly?
In the auricle, in the ventricle,
or in some other chamber, stealthily?
The bosom knows not how to tell apart
The pain from the anguish,
The weal from the woe,
The loneliness from solitude,
The wait from fortitude!
The rustle of the leaves,
The birds in the front eaves,
The still water in the pond
The dews a-tremble on the frond!
All remind me of those bygone days
of the past,
When gaiety, festivities even pleasantries
had a full blast!
